mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS is declining are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE > 4.5% indicates a soft labor market under accommodative monetary policy, which typically precedes equity market rallies as investors anticipate further rate cuts and fiscal stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative policy with soft labor market
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand as measured by RSAFS (Residential Sales, excluding new homes), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 20 trading days because rising consumer spending signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, which are positive for equities.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns during periods of RSAFS above the 90th percentile are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in stronger economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 (quarterly growth rate increase) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market, which often leads to accelerating wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE < 3.5% for two consecutive months are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising HOUST (residential construction) combined with a falling INDPRO (industrial production) signals a shift in economic activity towards the housing sector, which is typically resilient and supports consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM change > 0.5% AND INDPRO MoM change < -0.5%
regime_hint: housing sector resilience amid manufacturing slowdown
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, which indicates a manufacturing slowdown, the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks, especially when the decline is sustained for two months.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns during periods of INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
